title:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$env:AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION='ji-stage1-accept-001'
$psi=[System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
$psi.FileName='cmd.exe'
$psi.UseShellExecute=$false
$psi.RedirectStandardOutput=$true
$psi.RedirectStandardError=$true
$psi.CreateNoWindow=$true
$psi.WorkingDirectory=(Get-Location).Path
$psi.ArgumentList.Add('/d')
$psi.ArgumentList.Add('/c')
$psi.ArgumentList.Add('.\gradlew.bat :ji-host-web:runStage1HostFixture --offline')
$fixtureProc=[System.Diagnostics.Process]::new()
$fixtureProc.StartInfo=$psi
[void]$fixtureProc.Start()
$deadline=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(40)
$readyUrl=$null
while((-not $fixtureProc.HasExited) -and [DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline){
  $line=$fixtureProc.StandardOutput.ReadLine()
  if($line -and $line.StartsWith('STAGE1_HOST_READY ')){
    $readyUrl=$line.Substring('STAGE1_HOST_READY '.Length)
    break
  }
}
if(-not $readyUrl){
  if(-not $fixtureProc.HasExited){$fixtureProc.Kill($true)}
  throw 'Stage1HostFixture did not become ready'
}
& npx --yes agent-browser open $readyUrl | Out-Null
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){
  $fixtureProc.Kill($true)
  throw "agent-browser open failed: $LASTEXITCODE"
}
'REAL_HOST_BROWSER_READY'
$fixtureProc.WaitForExit()
exit $fixtureProc.ExitCode
